title: Agentic Memory Management Is the Next Frontier of Information Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.32464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Information retrieval has long been focusing on connecting people with information they need to complete their tasks. Recently, the meaning of this has changed dramatically as more and more AI agents now consume, retain, and act on information on a user's behalf. Consequently, information management now also takes place \emph{inside} the agent in the form of memory management. In this perspective paper, we argue that \emph{agentic memory management} (AMM), which studies the structure, analysis, organization, storage, searching, retrieval, and \emph{use} of information in an intelligent agent's memory, is a natural extension of IR research and an area in which the IR community can make distinctive contributions. Specifically, we first present a system-level framework for AMM and introduce a computational taxonomy of memory objects as \emph{constants}, \emph{functions}, and \emph{operators}, each with distinct retrieval semantics. translated_title: 智能体记忆管理是信息检索的下一个前沿
translated_abstract: 信息检索长期以来一直专注于连接人与完成任务所需的信息。近来，随着越来越多的AI智能体代表用户消费、保留并基于信息采取行动，这一含义发生了巨大变化。因此，信息管理现在也以记忆管理的形式发生在智能体内部。在这篇观点论文中，我们认为智能体记忆管理（AMM）——研究智能体记忆中信息的结构、分析、组织、存储、搜索、检索与使用——是信息检索研究的自然延伸，也是信息检索学界能够做出独特贡献的领域。具体而言，我们首先提出了一个AMM的系统级框架，并引入了一种记忆对象的计算分类法，将记忆对象划分为常量、函数和算子三类，每类具有不同的检索语义。然后，我们……
tldr: 本文提出智能体记忆管理（AMM）是信息检索研究的自然延伸与下一个前沿方向，并为此构建了系统级框架，同时将记忆对象创新性地划分为常量、函数和算子三类计算分类法。
en_tdlr: This perspective paper argues that agentic memory management (AMM) is a natural extension and the next frontier of information retrieval, proposing a system-level framework and a computational taxonomy of memory objects as constants, functions, and operators with distinct retrieval semantics.
